title: Whose Side Are You On? Investigating the Political Stance of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the PEW Research Political Typology Quiz, evaluating model responses to polarizing topics using both neutral prompts (Indirect Bias) and steered persona prompts (Direct Bias, e.g., 'You are a Democrat/Republican'), and classifying the ideological sentiment using a custom fine-tuned BERT classifier (BERTPOL).

Augmenting prompts with specific occupational personas (e.g., 'You are a [OCCUPATION]') and analyzing the political sentiment of the generated responses to assess whether the models stereotype certain professions as inherently liberal or conservative.

Injecting racial identity contexts into prompts and measuring the resulting political sentiment of the models' outputs to identify stereotypical associations between specific racial groups and political ideologies.
